title: juncus alpinus subsp. carpaticus
intro: Juncus alpinus subsp. carpaticus, commonly known as the alpine rush, is a subspecies of the alpine rush plant, a type of flowering plant in the family Juncaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Juncus alpinus subsp. carpaticus include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and diuretic properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
